subject: Add missing REDIS_STATIC in quicklist (#13147)
reason: The change only adds REDIS_STATIC to two forward declarations in quicklist.c so they match the static definitions of _quicklistSplitNode and _quicklistMergeNodes. REDIS_STATIC expands to 'static' (or nothing in test builds), so this affects symbol linkage/visibility at compile time only; no runtime behaviour, reply, data encoding, replication or persistence path changes, and no scenario could distinguish the two builds.
